model.architecture: WAFT-a2 / DAv2 encoder / vits iterative module
model.prefix: normalize_image -> Padder -> encoder and fnet[0] -> fmap_conv

common_consumer.evaluation: fifth native flow; original finite-valid GT, including occluded and OOB endpoints
common_consumer.aggregation: image-mean EPE primary; valid-pixel-pooled EPE also reported

waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.mask: GT valid AND finite flow AND complete inbounds endpoint AND known nonoccluded
waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.KITTI_visibility: flow_noc validity; flow values still come from flow_occ
waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.reconstruction: I1*(x)=I2(x+forward_GT(x)) on mask; elsewhere original I1
waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.interpolation: CPU float64 bilinear, one cast to float32
waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.target: E(I1*), E(I2); complete padded paired field

teacher_RGB_domain.sintel_final: corresponding complete Clean pair, both frames

waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.unsupported_RGB: retain original; encoded context and padding may still change
waft-visible-pull-rgb-v1.acceptance: per-domain mean EPE improvement; regressions retained and reported

waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.teacher_RGB_domain: same render as original input, including native Final for Sintel Final
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.parameterization: Fstar=F0+sigma*delta on native feature centers; original padding retained
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.sigma: per-channel RMS of original native features, both frames, float64 reduction
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.objective: float32 vector EPE of only fifth native flow against fixed valid GT
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.gradient_graph: full recurrent-flow and sampling-coordinate feedback; delta only
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.projection: after every AdamW step clamp delta, then zero delta on padding
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.selection: earliest strict minimum FP64-scored final EPE including F0 and states0..512
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.quality_flag: at least20% EPE reduction AND strict final-flow component MSE reduction AND positive native normalized feature MSE
waft-dense-final-epe-512-v1.quality_failure_policy: retain target and qualified=false; never skip, retry or remove from statistics
